sentences.text: % 15.03.2024 CRL.M.A. 7742/2024 in BAIL APPLN. 892/2024 (interim directions)

1. The present application is filed under Section 439 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('CrPC') seeking grant of interim bail in FIR No. 8/2023 dated 04.01.2023 registered at Police Station Punjabi Bagh for offences under Sections 406/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, on the ground that the wife of the applicant is suffering from various pre-existing ailments.

2. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that on 15.10.2021, the wife of the applicant had suffered two Transient Ischemic Attacks i.e. temporary slurry speech and was diagnosed with 90%
blockage in left common carotid artery.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/03/2024 at 02:55:27 3.
Thereafter, on 08.08.2022, she suffered third Transient Ischemic Attacks and she was hospitalised for three days where two of her arteries were detected to be 90% blocked.
She underwent various surgical procedures.
Thereafter, in the month of January, 2024, she fractured her right ankle and was on complete bed rest for 1.5 months.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant submits that, recently, the wife of the applicant again suffered fourth Transient Ischemic Attack and has been advised urgent admission to the hospital for check-up and observation.
He submits that the health condition of the wife of the applicant is precarious and requires urgent diagnostic and medical intervention.

5. On being asked, if final arguments can be heard in the present bail application (BAIL APPLN.
892/2024), the learned counsel for the complainant and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State requested that another date be fixed for arguments in the bail application.
6. The medical condition of the wife of the applicant is also not denied by the respondent.

7. Considering the aforesaid fact, the present application is allowed and the applicant is directed to be released on interim bail till 27.03.2024 on furnishing a bail bond for a sum of 50,000/- with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Jail Superintendent on the following conditions:
a.
The applicant shall under no circumstance leave NCT of Delhi, without permission of the learned Trial Court, during the period of his release on interim bail; b.

The applicant shall provide his mobile number to the concerned Investigating Officer,
which shall be kept switched on at all times;
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/03/2024 at 02:55:27 c.
The applicant shall not try to contact or influence any of the witnesses;
d. The applicant shall not commit any offence during the period of his release on interim bail.
8. The Jail Superintendent is directed to verify the bail bond expeditiously.
9. The application stands allowed in the aforesaid terms.

10. List for consideration on 27.03.2024.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J MARCH 15, 2024 "SS"
